questions.question: Many poisonous products are also:
questions.explanation: Many poisonous materials are also flammable.

questions.question: When turning to avoid a hazard:

options.text: You should not brake because it may lock the wheels.

questions.correctAnswerText: You should not brake because it may lock the wheels.
questions.explanation: Do not brake while turning to avoid a hazard. Braking can lock your wheels and cause your vehicle to skid out of control.

questions.question: When driving:

options.text: It is best to hide your intentions from others.
You should only use turn signals if other vehicles are nearby.
You should not use turn signals in construction zones.
You should always use turn signals to warn others of your plans.

questions.correctAnswerText: You should always use turn signals to warn others of your plans.
questions.explanation: Always signal before turning or changing lanes. This tells other drivers what you plan to do, even if no other vehicles are nearby.

questions.question: Broken suspension parts:
questions.explanation: The suspension system supports your vehicle and keeps the axles in place. Broken suspension parts are very dangerous.

questions.question: If involved in an accident, which action is not recommended?

options.text: Moving your vehicle to the side of the road

questions.explanation: After an accident, protect the area, call authorities, help the injured, get information from others, and report the accident. Leaving the scene can result in losing your license.

questions.question: Containers of nitric acid should be:

options.text: Stacked no more than two containers high.
Placed on top of other products.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stacked no more than two containers high.
questions.explanation: Nitric acid containers can be stacked, but only two containers high. Never stack them higher or place them on top of other products.

questions.question: Drivers behind slow-moving vehicles often:

options.text: Are happy with the slow speed.

questions.explanation: Drivers often tailgate slow-moving vehicles. If someone is tailgating you, let them pass safely.

questions.question: The steering wheel should be:

options.text: Held with one hand to eat or drink while driving.
Held by one hand at a time, switching hands.

questions.explanation: Always hold the steering wheel with both hands. Place your hands on opposite sides of the wheel for proper control.

questions.question: Keeping space between your vehicle and the one ahead is:

options.text: Not recommended because it slows traffic.
Recommended because it gives you time to react to hazards.
Only recommended if you have a passenger.

questions.correctAnswerText: Recommended because it gives you time to react to hazards.
questions.explanation: Keep space around your vehicle on all sides. This gives you time to react safely if a problem occurs.

questions.question: When loading a tank divided into smaller tanks, the heaviest load should be:
questions.explanation: When loading a tank with smaller sections, put the heaviest load in the middle. Do not put too much weight at the front or rear.

questions.question: What is a bobtail tractor?

options.text: A tractor that travels faster than the speed limit

questions.explanation: A bobtail tractor is a tractor without a semi-trailer attached. These tractors are hard to handle. Drivers must be very careful when operating them.

questions.question: If a tire fails while you are driving, what should you do?

options.text: Stay off the brakes and let the vehicle slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay off the brakes and let the vehicle slow down.
questions.explanation: If a tire fails, grip the steering wheel firmly. Do not use the brakes. Let the vehicle slow down on its own. Once it is going slowly, brake gently. Then pull off the road and stop.

questions.question: When should you turn off a retarder for safety?

options.text: When you are carrying a passenger
When you are carrying a heavy load

questions.explanation: A retarder is a device that slows a vehicle and reduces braking. But retarders can cause wheels to slip on wet or icy roads. Turn off retarders when roads are wet, snowy, or icy.

questions.question: Where may hazardous materials shipping papers NOT be kept?

options.text: In a pouch on the driver's door.
In a pouch on the passenger's side door.
Within reach of the driver while the seat belt is fastened.

questions.correctAnswerText: In a pouch on the passenger's side door.
questions.explanation: Shipping papers must be easy to find in an emergency. Keep them in a pouch on the driver's door or in plain sight and within reach while wearing your seat belt. You can place papers on the driver's seat when the driver is not in the vehicle.

questions.question: What happens if you stay in neutral too long while shifting gears?

options.text: You may have trouble putting the vehicle into the next gear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may have trouble putting the vehicle into the next gear.
questions.explanation: If you stay in neutral too long while shifting, you may have trouble engaging the next gear. Do not force the gear shift. Return to neutral, release the clutch, speed up the engine to match the road speed, and try again.

questions.question: After connecting the air lines to the trailer while coupling, what should you do next?
questions.explanation: Coupling and uncoupling trailers correctly is essential for safe operation of combination vehicles. After connecting the air lines to the trailer, supply air to the trailer.

questions.question: What is the number one cause of death and injury in work zones?
questions.explanation: Speeding is the main cause of death and injury in work zones. Be extra careful when driving near workers.

questions.question: When can mirror adjustment be checked correctly?

options.text: There is no trailer attached to the tractor.
The vehicle is on a slight incline.
The vehicle is on a slight decline.

questions.explanation: If a trailer is attached to the tractor, you can only check mirror adjustment correctly when the trailer is straight.

questions.question: What do shut-off valves do?

options.text: Prevent air from escaping air brake systems.
Prevent air from entering air brake systems.
Override vehicles that are out of control.

questions.correctAnswerText: Prevent air from escaping air brake systems.
questions.explanation: Shut-off valves control air flow between trailers. Always keep the rear shut-off valve closed to prevent air from leaving the braking system.

questions.question: What determines your blood alcohol concentration (BAC)?
questions.explanation: Your blood alcohol concentration is determined by how much alcohol you drink, how fast you drink it, and your body weight.
